def: Letting a cheap draft propose several tokens that the large model verifies in one forward pass, producing the same output distribution in fewer large-model passes.
The small, fast model that proposes candidate tokens in speculative decoding.
The large model whose output distribution speculative decoding must reproduce and which verifies the draft's tokens.
The probability that a drafted token is accepted by the target, equal to the overlap between the draft and target distributions.
The distribution proportional to max(0, p - q) from which a replacement token is drawn when a drafted token is rejected, which makes the overall output exactly p.
Extra output heads added to a model, each predicting a token further ahead, so one pass produces several candidates to verify.
A speculative method that drafts by predicting the target model's next hidden feature rather than the next token.
Drafting by copying the tokens that followed an earlier occurrence of the latest tokens in the prompt, with no draft model.
